capabilities.text: Build the tree: 2 to 16 taxa, grouped into clades inside clades
Put the taxa in any order
capabilities.note: Ours draws the leaves in the typed order.

capabilities.text: Give each clade a trait, and the root one trait shared by every taxon
capabilities.note: Ours writes the name at the clade’s branching point (a typed ancestor name), not as a tick on the branch; see cap-02b.

capabilities.text: Draw each trait as a tick on the branch leading into its clade
capabilities.note: Ours has no ticks; a trait name sits at the node.

capabilities.text: Start from a setup (vertebrates, land plants, apes, taxa A to F with numbered traits)
capabilities.note: A preset list is one capability (owner decision 2026-11-08). Token is our “A slanted tree of vertebrates” example; ours has apes and vertebrates examples but no land plants or A–F numbered-trait setup.

capabilities.text: Draw diagonal branches with the taxa along the top
capabilities.note: Ours’ slanted shape keeps the taxa down the right; no taxa-along-the-top layout.

capabilities.text: Draw rectangular branches with the taxa down the right
capabilities.note: The opening state; the token shows the switch that reaches it is live.

capabilities.text: Write the taxon names as blank lines
Write the traits as numbered blank lines
Show the traits as ticks alone, with no names
Leave the traits off without deleting them
capabilities.note: Ours shows whatever is typed; traits are removed only by editing the tree text.
